architecture.purpose: M06 exchanges a verified independent single-document copy with necessary material versions; validates before action; applies one target-document merge with one Undo or creates a separately authorized new project copy. It never executes imported code or mutates source package.
architecture.hexagonal: Editor/Test → closed exchange commands → DispatchHost ExchangeOwner → HOST BinExchange → existing proposed pure WORK preflight. Output ports: immutable ArchiveSource/ExportStore, M04 capture/candidate commit, M05 material pin/export/import, M01 new-project copy, M07 root observation. Windows adapter implements safe source/export handles. Domain has no archive/filesystem/UI dependency.
architecture.dependency_map: M01 identity +M04 single document owner → M06 capture/plan; M05 immutable versions/pins ↔ M06 copy manifest; M06 validated candidate → M04 one S1 MutationKind::Merge; history roots → M05 five-kind aggregation, including M07 recovery. No M06-owned second document model.

ownership.M06: Immutable source snapshot, validation report, preview mapping/plan and operation evidence.
ownership.M01: New project UUID/directory/definition adoption and publication. Foreign source UUID is provenance only.
ownership.M04: Target content/revision/semantic fingerprint/formal+recovery baselines and Undo/Redo. Only owner commits merge.
ownership.M05: Catalog IDs/version hashes, durable pins and root transitions; eligibility not deletion.
ownership.M07: Recovery payload/index/root evidence; merge/import cannot clear retained snapshots.
ownership.adapter: Safe source handle/owned export staging and bounded stream; not business identity policy.

architecture.transactions: Validate+preview no target content writes. Acquire durable material pin before target commit. M04 single commit atomically replaces one in-memory document and pushes one Undo. Catalog/target/formal file are separate transactions; postcommit root transfer can defer, never false rollback. Export is immutable stage→no-replace publication; new project is separate M01 transaction.
architecture.scope: ESS standalone copy, proposed BIN-v1 self-contained package, validation/incomplete external confirmation, explicit identity mapping, one-document merge+Undo, new project copy. ZIP compatibility, legacy SGB migration, automatic save, execution/build, physical cleanup and cross-document merge are separate tasks.
architecture.approval: Preflight F1-F3 document acceptance preserved, not product or R1-R4 adoption. New choices below pending Owner; no Skeleton.

archive.choice: Recommended A: uncompressed deterministic framed BIN-v1 below, no archive dependency. Alternative B ZIP requires separate exact dependency/feature/lock/security envelope and remains unsupported here. New BIN is not legacy SGB1; no signature guessing, silent conversion or renaming.
archive.framing: 8-byte ASCII magic SGABIN1 followed by LF (hex53 47 41 42 49 4e 31 0a); next8bytes unsigned little-endian manifest length M; then exactly M bytes UTF8 JSON manifest; then entry data concatenated in manifest order. Entry offsets relative to first data byte, contiguous from0, no holes/overlaps/trailing bytes. Checked u64 addition before seek/read. No compression/encryption/symlink attributes or filesystem extraction.
archive.manifest: Fixed fields {schema:"SGA-BIN-v1",version:1,source:{project_uuid,document_uuid,format,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,captured_revision},mode:DocumentWithAssets,entries:[{key,kind,size_bytes,digest,offset}],references:[{asset_id,digest,entry_key}],legacy_alias_mapping:[{alias,asset_id,digest}],missing_external:[{id,kind,target_id?}]}. Unknown/duplicate fields rejected. No self digest; source_digest=SHA256 all exact archive bytes, manifest_digest=SHA256 manifest raw bytes; not approval authority.
archive.entries: Exactly one document key document/payload with kind Document; immutable canonical internal document bytes verified through adopted M04 codec. Material keys assets/<lowerhex64> kind Asset. Unique exact keys, ASCII casefold unique, no other names. References sorted (asset_id UTF8,digest); distinct IDs may share content-digest entry. Every referenced internal asset exists, hash/size exact; every Asset entry used; document unreferenced only special mandatory entry. No arbitrary paths/components, ../,drive,UNC,NUL,backslash,colon,percent decoding or device names.
archive.canonical_export: UTF8 compact JSON, fixed manifest field/record order above, entries document first then asset digest ASCII order; sorted refs/aliases/external IDs by UTF8 bytes. Integers decimal unsigned no floats, offsets exact. No BOM/newline inside manifest. Source timestamps and machine paths omitted. Equal captured canonical content+asset pairs yields equal package bytes; no random container metadata.
archive.guards: Input total bytes cap first → magic/version/header/M range → strict UTF8/duplicate/type/JSON resource parse → entry table names/count/overflow/ranges/final length → streamed digest/size checks → M04 payload/schema/profile/identity/ref checks → exact reference closure/external classification → trusted target freshness → existing preflight policy. Grammar failure never becomes accepted incomplete. Manifest parser depth root0≤64 and per-string decoded UTF8≤1MiB; numeric unsigned u64 integer only.
archive.ess_mode: ESS export emits only full serialized EssXmlV1 aggregate from captured M04 codec. Requires complete material-free or explicitly external-only reference classification; internal assets requiring inclusion => RequiresBin. This is an Owner-proposed scope choice, not silent requirement reduction. Import plain ESS uses M04 codec and trusted project reference resolver; unresolved internal payload/material cannot be excused as external. Unsupported JSON design exchange remains explicit format choice rather than XML coercion.
archive.security: Treat payload/props/metadata inert. Never load scripts, expand archive paths, follow external URLs or execute imported commands. File extension irrelevant to trust; reject SGB1/ZIP/unknown versions deterministically. Duplicate raw JSON keys rejected before typed decode. Source snapshot copied/hashed under native safe handle and cannot reopen changed source by path.

merge_undo.preflight: Embed/reuse unchanged R1-R4+accepted F1-F3 exact64oracle document policy. Actual verified decoder creates report; UI cannot submit safe=true/report/blockers. Source digest+target document/revision bound; old report stale => reject. Allowed is not mutation permission/receipt.
merge_undo.identity_mapping: Preview enumerates every imported entity ID and typed internal reference. Recommended FreshImportedIds: server allocates new IDs for all imported entities and shows complete old→new mapping; caller explicitly confirms mapping digest. Alternative explicit mapping to existing target requires each identity and target type confirmed. Same name/label never matches automatically. Any uncertain/unsupported reference-bearing field blocks affected merge. Unknown structure cannot silently preserve a stale hidden reference.
merge_undo.scope: One source document→one selected target document plus necessary immutable assets only. ESS target aggregate work/architecture/design considered one physical document; all affected typed projections validated as one candidate. Any required edit to another physical document => existing CrossDocumentChangeRequired. No automatic new target/project switch during merge.
merge_undo.conflicts: Target project/doc/session/generation/revision and semantic profile/digest captured in plan. Asset pairs preserve explicit versions; catalog may add new version, never changes another document binding/latest pointer. Entity remap updates every supported internal edge/parent/binding; external IDs are preserved as explicit Pending only after allowed external confirmation. Duplicate IDs, cycles, invalid parent/type errors block.
merge_undo.preview: Server plan {plan_id,source_digest,target_identity,revision,before_semantic,candidate_semantic,mapping_digest,asset_manifest_digest,choice,affected_counts,blocked_capabilities,expires_at}; TTL60s monotonic,max16plans/runtime,max64MiB candidate memory. No target writes. Confirm DTO plan_id+preview_digest+operation_id; cannot inject candidate bytes/mapping at confirm.
merge_undo.apply: Revalidate immutable source and target, exact choice/mapping, IO-health and dependency evidence. Import verified assets into catalog +Held Candidate pin before commit. One M04 S1 commit after revalidation, one Undo with before+after complete content/required asset union. No-op produces unchanged revision/no Undo. Source bytes unchanged.
merge_undo.known_failure: Before S1 commit: target content/revision/history/formal+snapshot baselines unchanged; imported immutable catalog versions/orphan blobs may remain pinned/retained. Explicitly distinguish target rollback from removal of safe staged assets; no physical cleanup requirement hidden. Cancel before commit produces no history.
merge_undo.postcommit: Complete roots transfer after one M04 Merge commit; return common AppliedRetentionDeferred if needed, never unchanged failure. Same for Undo; source bytes/formal/recovery baselines unchanged.
merge_undo.undo: Existing M04 S1 undo expected current revision restores complete before state and pushes appropriate redo semantics as supported S1. Only public existing undo operation exposed; do not invent redo API. M05 roots retain versions for other documents/Undo/Redo/recovery/in-flight; Undo never deletes material. Root publication failure after undo=>UndoAppliedRetentionDeferred; keep union pins/old roots.
merge_undo.incomplete: Only ExplicitlyAcceptMissingExternal permits AllowedIncomplete. Store Pending bindings and blocked dependent capabilities in candidate, preserve exact external IDs; never invent valid endpoints/assets. Hard blockers remain first and cannot be bypassed by acceptance. Later resolving binding is separate owner edit with its own revision/history, not silent mutation.
merge_undo.projector_readiness: PROJECTOR_FIXTURES_REQUIRED: exact typed field/ref mapping for allowed ESS/design constructs before merge Skeleton. Uncertain IDs/unknown reference fields hard-block; explicit FreshImportedIds map preview only.

lifecycle.export: M04 stable immutable capture+complete ref projection → M05 durable Export-purpose pin (new pending PinPurpose amendment; not assume enum exists) → verified material copies → deterministic BIN bytes stream → native seal receipt. Export receipt does not ACK formal/recovery saves. Release pin only through M05 complete fresh roots; unavailable roots retain Held. Export pin timeout never deletes materials.
lifecycle.export_failure: Known failure before publish leaves no completed destination; owned stage may remain with explicit AbortFailed. No truncate of pre-existing file. After native publish but response lost return ExportPublishedDeliveryDeferred after proof reconciliation, never Cancelled/not-written. Archive source/destination immutable receipts retained.
lifecycle.validate_import: Capture source lease once, guard bytes, decode full document/material closure, register report+preview. Native source selection stale/size changed => fail. Inspect is not execute; no target mutation/catalog writes during validate/preview.

Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
new_project_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
new_project_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
new_project_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

lifecycle.replay: One apply operation per target at a time; runtime bounded128/session1024/runtime result cache, capacity rejects no eviction. Same operation body returns original receipt; different body ReplayConflict. After commit callback loss, query actual owner receipt; across restart exactly-once not claimed without new durable operation protocol. Never replay lost merge into a fresh target session.
lifecycle.close_switch: Plans/source leases revoked on close/project switch; applied proof and Held pins retained for reconciliation. Cancellation once commit/publish started awaits actual result; cannot claim rollback. Preview plan generation isolation prevents late apply to replacement session.
lifecycle.recovery: M04 RecoveryBlocked denies apply/undo; M05 uncertain catalog denies material import/transfer; new archive store identity uncertainty blocks export. No repair/unblock API. Prior recovery snapshots retained, and imported content will participate in normal M07 checks after actual M04 content mutation.

errors.shape: ExchangeError {code,stage,path?,reason,plan_id?,operation_id?,evidence?}; result variants ValidationBlocked|NeedsExternalConfirmation|PreviewReady|ExportPublished|MergeApplied|NoChange|MergeAppliedRetentionDeferred|UndoAppliedRetentionDeferred|ProjectCopyDeferred|Error; success/error/deferred semantics exclusive.
errors.ordering: Caller authorization/closed DTO→source byte/header bounds→lexical manifest and resource guards→table path/range/digest integrity→document codec/typed closure→actual preflight exact precedence→explicit external choice→identity mapping→target/dependency freshness→catalog pin→owner commit→root transfer. Error paths manifest RFC6901, document path per M04 profile; infrastructure paths only authorized diagnostics.
errors.preservation: Keep original ImportPreflightError, CommitError, MaterialError fields; never map hard blocker to missing_external. Known precommit target preservation distinct from catalog retained orphans; committed deferred never ordinary rollback failure.
errors.min_cases: 0byte archive, truncated1..15header, M=0/too-large, u64 overflow, same-size source changed, raw duplicatekey, named extra entry, corrupt payload/assets all explicit negative recipes. No ZIP bombs: ZIP/compression unsupported rather than invoking a decoder.

ui.internal_undo: Use existing adopted M04 document_undo with target context, not new independent M06 history manager.
ui.states: Validation blockers separated from external warnings. Explicit external acceptance unchecked default; disabled for any hard blocker. Preview exact one target, mappings, assets, Pending bindings and one-Undo effect; confirm/cancel. Deferred applied state displays actual target revision and retained pin; error preserves active draft. New project copy clearly separate action.
ui.ACL: Editor only; Viewer cannot import/export/apply/copy. UI sends no raw arbitrary root/path, manifest safe flags, approval refs or candidate bytes at confirm. IDs ASCII1..128, deny unknown fields, trust actual window instance not label.
ui.accessibility: Keyboard choose/review/confirm/cancel; blocker focus, aria-live progress/deferred; no success toast from validation-only report.

decisions.proposal: Adopt framed uncompressed BIN-v1 A and strict manifest/table/closure limits; ZIP/SGB compatibility separate; ESS internal-material export RequiresBin choice explicit.
Adopt immutable source/export Ports and native no-replace publication; no imported execution/extraction/dependency downloads.
Adopt exact preflight R1-R4 plus already document-accepted F1-F3 without semantic weakening; hard blockers never bypassed.
Adopt explicit preview FreshImportedIds mapping and one-document M04 Merge/Undo, no label matching/hidden cross-document edits.
Adopt M05 verified import/export pins (new Export purpose), roots and postcommit deferred statuses; separate M07 preservation.
Adopt explicit M01 new-project copy seam/new identities/provenance and partial-publication blocked outcomes; no inherited approval or cross-document Undo.
Adopt commands/errors/replay/cancel/envelope and acceptance gates; product remains not ready before dependencies/Skeleton/RED.
